local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local elapsed=0;local reported=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() or reported then return end
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<5 then return end
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died on Sigil base continuation')
 assert(self.cell.id==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x1d0c8),'Wrong tower cell')
 assert((self.position-util.vector3(-1312,0,-240)):length()<160,'Actual lower doorway not retained')
 local found=false
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if obj.id=='0x1098138' then
   assert(not types.Actor.isDead(obj),'Ilend died on continuation')
   assert((obj.position-self.position):length()<400,'Ilend did not retain bounded follow');found=true
  end
 end
 assert(found,'Ilend is absent')
 local ray=nearby.castRay(util.vector3(-475,-760,-200),util.vector3(-475,-450,-200),{{collisionType=nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.World+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.Door+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.HeightMap}})
 assert(not ray.hit or not ray.hitObject or ray.hitObject.id~='0x10c48e4','Sigil base offset is lost after fresh-process animation')
 local floor=nearby.castRay(self.position+util.vector3(0,0,32),self.position-util.vector3(0,0,64),{{collisionType=nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.World+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.Door+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.HeightMap}})
 assert(floor.hit and floor.hitNormal.z>.6,'Doorway has no walkable support')
 local gap=self.position.z-floor.hitPos.z;assert(gap>=-.1 and gap<48,'Player is not supported by the floor')
 reported=true;print('BloodFeast cold collision verified position='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
end}}}}
